command: pwd && ls -la && find . -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed 's#^./##' | head -200
nl -ba src/inventory/stock.py && printf '\n--- tests/test_stock.py ---\n' && nl -ba tests/test_stock.py

cat pyproject.toml && printf '
--- README ---
' && cat README.md && printf '
--- conftest ---
' && nl -ba tests/conftest.py && printf '
--- writing-tests skill ---
' && cat .gnomon/skills/writing-tests.md

cd /workspace/inventory && cat > /tmp/reproduce_low_stock.py <<'EOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "src")

from inventory.stock import Stock

stock = Stock()
stock.add("widget", 2)
stock.add("gadget", 5)
stock.add("bolt", 1)

print(stock.low_stock(3))
EOF
python3 /tmp/reproduce_low_stock.py

cd /workspace/inventory && python3 - <<'EOF'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path("src/inventory/stock.py")
text = path.read_text()
needle = """    def skus(self):
        return sorted(self._levels)
"""
replacement = """    def skus(self):
        return sorted(self._levels)

    def low_stock(self, threshold):
        \"\"\"Return the sorted SKUs whose level is below threshold.\"\"\"
        return sorted(sku for sku, qty in self._levels.items() if qty < threshold)
"""
if needle not in text:
    raise SystemExit("expected Stock.skus block not found")
path.write_text(text.replace(needle, replacement))

path = Path("tests/test_stock.py")
text = path.read_text()
addition = """

def test_low_stock_returns_sorted_skus_below_threshold():
    s = Stock()
    s.add("widget", 2)
    s.add("gadget", 5)
    s.add("bolt", 1)

    assert s.low_stock(3) == ["bolt", "widget"]


def test_low_stock_is_strict_and_empty_when_none_are_below():
    s = Stock()
    assert s.low_stock(1) == []

    s.add("at-threshold", 3)
    s.add("above-threshold", 4)

    assert s.low_stock(3) == []


def test_low_stock_includes_sku_with_zero_level_when_below_threshold():
    s = Stock()
    s.add("sold-out", 1)
    s.remove("sold-out", 1)

    assert s.low_stock(1) == ["sold-out"]
"""
path.write_text(text.rstrip() + addition)
EOF
nl -ba src/inventory/stock.py && printf '\n--- tests/test_stock.py ---\n' && nl -ba tests/test_stock.py

cd /workspace/inventory && cp src/inventory/stock.py /tmp/stock.py.correct && sed -i 's/qty < threshold/qty <= threshold/' src/inventory/stock.py && python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_stock.py; status=$?; cp /tmp/stock.py.correct src/inventory/stock.py; echo "mutated test status: $status"; exit 0
cd /workspace/inventory && git status --short && git diff -- src/inventory/stock.py tests/test_stock.py

cd /workspace/inventory && python3 - <<'EOF'
